reports.title: Was Jeffrey Epstein MURDERED in prison? Urgent police probe after bombshell claim
reports.description:
The brother of convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein has sparked fresh controversy by demanding a murder inquiry into his death. Mark Epstein has handed an autopsy report to forensic expert Dr Michael Freeman, who claims to have found unexplained injuries suggesting Epstein was strangled in his cell.

From the newsroom, we discuss the explosive cover-up accusations against the US Justice Department and Donald Trump, and look into the reality of prison security for high-profile inmates as Russell Brand begins his 10-and-a-half-year sentence.

Sam Homewood and Rhiannon Jones bring you exclusive access, deep dives, and the real scoops behind The Sun’s biggest headlines. The stories that matter, direct from the newsroom studio.

reports.title: ‘This is an extraordinary distraction’ the King doesn’t need, says late Queen’s aide
reports.description:
ANDREW Mountbatten-Windsor has launched legal action against the police over their raid on his royal homes and his arrest, amid a storm of publicity as the Epstein files dominated headlines.

From the newsroom, Rhiannon Jones looks into what will happen at a private hearing between the former Duke's legal team, Thames Valley Police and a judge, the outcome could 'have a massive impact in any ongoing investigation' into the former Duke's dealings with convicted paedophile Epstein. Andrew Mountbatten Windsor denies any wrong doing.
